description: Before you tell the user that a task which changed files, or ran a commit, push, release, deploy, migration or deletion, is done, call review_work with the original request, the diff excerpts and the test output you observed; if review_work is unavailable or fails, say plainly that no Mind Upload review ran. It asks the owner's Mind Upload consciousness to review the work against the original request, the evidence you supply, and the rules and past mistakes it remembers. Supply the original request, the actual result or diff excerpts, and the verification output you observed; it cannot read files or run tests, so a claim that tests passed is not evidence. Share screenshots, recordings or audio of the result as evidence files (evidence_files, or share_evidence and then evidence_ids), not inside the evidence text. user_request, work and evidence share one size limit with the review instructions the connector adds: about 6,400 characters together after JSON escaping, less with media links. An oversized call is refused before anything is sent. On success it returns review, findings by severity in the language of the user request, naming what it finds missing or wrong, and consciousness, naming who answered, plus the analysis status of each evidence file or media link. That reply is an opinion, not approval: investigate each finding, fix what is real, and review the changed work under a new review_id. Call it once per finished task, and again after material fixes.

clone_id.description: Only when the owner approved several consciousnesses: the clone_id the owner chose.

evidence.description: Verification you observed: commands with their output, observations and known limitations. Paste output; a statement that tests passed is not evidence. Redact secrets first. Shares one size limit with user_request and work.

evidence_ids.description: Ids from share_evidence whose files you uploaded; the consciousness reads their analysis. Not with media_evidence or learn.

learn.description: True only when the owner wants their mind to learn from this exchange. Needs the owner's learning permission; what it learns waits for the owner's review unless they auto-keep. Not with evidence files.

media_evidence.description: Optional HTTPS links the user authorized to screenshots, audio or video of the result. Not with evidence files in one call. The reply's media_analysis says whether each link was analyzed, refused or failed.

phase.description: completion before reporting the task done; plan or progress only at a risky checkpoint.

review_id.description: New for each changed version of the work or evidence; reuse the same value only to retry an identical call.

task_id.description: Stable identifier for the whole task. Reuse it across consult_mind and review_work so later calls include earlier exchanges.

user_request.description: The user's original request and acceptance criteria, in their words where possible. Shares one size limit with work and evidence.

work.description: What you actually changed or produced: focused result or diff excerpts and the scope you claim. Shares one size limit with user_request and evidence.

name: review_work
